faq.refferal2: Will I receive a reward for inviting friends?
faq.refferal_ans2:
Of course! We generously reward those who invite friends to our project.

You will receive 10% in three levels (5%-3%-2%) from each purchase your referral makes.
faq.refferal_ans1: Yes, on the Friends page you can invite your friends and see full referral statistics.
faq.balance3: How fast is the balance topped up or withdrawn?
faq.balance_ans3: TON top-up and withdrawal are instant and take no more than 30 seconds.
faq.balance_ans2:
On the Balance page, there's a withdrawal form. Enter your wallet address and click MAX.

Minimum withdrawal is 0.1 TON.
faq.balance1: How to top up the balance?
faq.balance_ans1: Simply go to the Balance page, connect your TON wallet, or use direct transfer via MEMO.
faq.what_civilization_ans3: To start, top up your Balance and buy your first Planet.
faq.what_civilization_ans2:
Yes, you can earn real rewards in TON.

But remember, CivilizationTon is a game, and all top-ups are considered voluntary donations.
faq.what_civilization_ans: Civilization is a unique P2E game where you can earn rewards in TON.
